title: Picnic Plans

pre.en: What do Chen and Tom forget to take to the park?
pre.zh: Chen 和 Tom 忘了带什么去公园？

intro: 第 1 单元的最后一课，也是复习课：Tom 约了香蕉周认识的邻居周日去野餐，可他什么都担心。前面九课学过的时态都藏在对话里：现在时、过去时、used to、几种完成时，还有几种说将来的方式。新加的是「如果……就会……」的第一条件句。王太太和扫地机器人也回来了。

sentences.en: I've invited the neighbours from banana week to a picnic on Sunday!
sentences.zh: 我约了香蕉周认识的那些邻居，周日一起去野餐！
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I haven't had a picnic for years.
But what if it rains?
If it rains, we'll stay in and eat on the living room floor.
sentences.zh: 要是下雨，我们就待在家里，坐在客厅地板上吃。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: So what are you going to make?
Sandwiches.
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Or pasta.
No, sandwiches!
Well, it depends what people like.
Tom, you've changed your mind three times in ten seconds.
sentences.zh: Tom，你十秒钟改了三回主意了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Just make up your mind!
If you don't, we'll end up with nothing.
sentences.zh: 再这么下去，我们最后什么都吃不上。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I've been checking the forecast all week.
sentences.zh: 我这一个星期一直在看天气预报。

sentences.en: I'll bring umbrellas, just in case.
And Mrs Wang's coming over tonight to help me sort out the food.
sentences.zh: 还有，王太太今晚过来，帮我把吃的弄好。

sentences.en: Relax.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: If we plan ahead, nothing will go wrong.
sentences.zh: 只要提前计划好，就出不了岔子。

sentences.en: Famous last words.
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Sunday at last!
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Here we are, and on time too.
Nobody else has turned up yet.
sentences.zh: 其他人还一个都没到呢。

sentences.en: So... where's the food?
I thought you had it!
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Oh no.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's still on the kitchen table.
If we turn back now, someone else will get the best spot.
sentences.zh: 要是现在回去拿，最好的位置就被别人占了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Don't panic.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Look, here's Mrs Wang, with an enormous basket.
sentences.zh: 你看，王太太来了，还提着个大篮子。

sentences.en: Hello, boys!
sentences.speaker: Mrs Wang

sentences.en: I was watering my plants when I saw you two leave with nothing in your hands.
sentences.zh: 我正在浇花，就看见你们俩两手空空地出门了。

sentences.en: So I've brought some banana bread.
sentences.zh: 所以我带了点香蕉面包过来。

sentences.en: You're a star, Mrs Wang.
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Well, I used to cook for a big family, so I always make too much.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我以前要给一大家子做饭，所以每次都做多。
sentences.speaker: Mrs Wang

sentences.en: And is your vacuum still working night shifts, Chen?
sentences.zh: 对了小陈，你的扫地机器人还上夜班吗？

sentences.en: No, it works days now.
sentences.zh: 不上了，它现在改上白班了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You know, three months ago, I didn't know anyone in this building.
sentences.zh: 说起来，三个月前，这栋楼里我一个人都不认识。

sentences.en: And now you can't get rid of us.
sentences.zh: 现在想甩都甩不掉我们了。
sentences.speaker: Mrs Wang

sentences.en: Right, help yourselves!
Thanks — I already have.
sentences.speaker: Tom

cards.note: to stay at home and not go out
cards.tip: 反义是 go out（出去玩）；也可以说 stay at home，stay in 更口语。
cards.example: I'm tired — I think I'll stay in tonight.

cards.note: used to say that the answer will change because of something else
cards.tip: 说取决于什么用 on：It depends on the weather；单说 It depends. 也行，是一种不把话说死的回答。
cards.example: Will the meeting be long? — It depends on the client.

cards.note: to decide something, especially after thinking about it for a long time
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：make up my mind / his mind；拿不定主意是 can't make up your mind。
cards.example: I can't make up my mind about the new job offer.

cards.note: to be in a place or situation in the end, often without planning it
完整说法是 weather forecast；作动词是「预测」：Rain is forecast for Sunday。
because something might happen
cards.tip: 放在句末最常见：Take an umbrella, just in case.；后面也可以接一句话：just in case it rains。别和 in case of（如果发生……时）混。
cards.example: Save a copy of the file, just in case.

cards.note: to come to the place where someone is, especially their home
cards.tip: 第 5 课是父母「提前一天过来了」；这里用现在进行时说约好的安排：are coming over tonight。
cards.example: A few colleagues are coming over for drinks on Friday.

cards.note: to organise something that is untidy, or to deal with a problem
cards.tip: 后面接要安排、要解决的事：sort out the food / the tickets / a problem；代词放中间：sort it out。
cards.example: Can you sort out the tickets for the conference?

cards.note: to make plans for something before it happens
cards.tip: ahead 是「提前、在前面」：think ahead 提前考虑。plan ahead 后面一般不直接跟宾语。
cards.example: If you plan ahead, release week doesn't have to be stressful.

cards.zh: 这话说早了；别把话说太满
cards.note: 别人说「肯定没问题」时，半开玩笑地回这么一句：这种话一说出口，往往就要出事。
at the right time, not late
cards.tip: on time 是按约好的时间、不晚；「早一点、来得及做某事」用 in time：in time for the best spot。第 7 课是客人准时到，这次轮到他们自己要准时。
cards.example: If the train is on time, I'll be at the office by ten.

cards.note: to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
to return the way you came, before you reach the place you were going to
cards.tip: turn back 是半路掉头往回走；还没出发、或者已经到了再回去，一般用 go back。
cards.example: We had to turn back because the road was closed.

cards.note: a good spot for a picnic 野餐的好地方；spot 还有「斑点」的意思。
比 big 大得多，本身已经是「极大」，前面不加 very。第 9 课送货小哥扛的也是 an enormous box。
picnic basket 野餐篮；shopping basket 购物篮（网购的「购物车」英式也叫 basket）。
water 作动词是「浇水」：water the plants 浇花；作名词才是「水」。
work days 上白班，work nights 上夜班，和第 1 课的 night shifts 对着说：扫地机器人终于改成白天干活了。
to throw away, sell or give away something you do not want
to take food or drink without waiting for someone to serve you
